adm.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 107 ADM locations, with 32 in Illinois, 18 in Indiana and 10 in Nebraska, and smaller counts in Kansas, Missouri and on out to Washington and New York. Towns run from Decatur and Creve Coeur to Evansville, Fremont, Hutchinson and Spokane. The table carries corn, soybeans and wheat.
